title: A turn whose input reads as nothing joins its notes to the conversation's last message when it is a user's, as it joins them to an input
notes: Python's with_turn_notes: the notes follow the last message's text when it is a user message, or come as a user message of their own when the conversation does not end on one; some chat formats refuse two user messages in a row. The agent's first answer is empty, so no answer of its own follows the first message; the second message reads as nothing (the describer says nothing of it) and is left out.
